Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the attachments. Short answer: yes, we can do automatic issuance through our Self-Serve Accelerator portal once verification is complete. To keep this automated and fast we need the following minimal checklist uploaded to the portal: 

1) Official accreditation letter (you attached) — must include program name and effective dates.
2) Cohort roster with startup names and verified admin emails (CSV fine).
3) A single program admin email (we’ll push credits to that account) and confirmation they accept program terms.
4) Proof of program domain ownership (one of: DNS TXT, support@domain email confirmation, or a signed letter on org letterhead).

I’ve created a temporary ticket for DV-2026-0842 and linked your attachments. If you upload the domain proof to the same folder or reply with a signed letter, the portal will auto-verify and schedule issuance. If any startup needs an individual override we can do manual top-ups, but default flow is program-admin issuance.

Portal link (upload here): https://console.redwood.ai/accelerators/upload/DV-2026-0842
Internal note: tagging @priyom for verification once items are uploaded.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Startup Programs — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(attachment referenced: accelerator_roster.csv)

Hi Samir — I pulled the CSV and accreditation PDF. Quick verification notes: 

- Rosters: looks good but one entry (Row 12: Nimbus Labs) is missing a verified admin email; please have the program admin add or confirm that address.
- Accreditation: valid, signed, matches program name and dates.
- Domain proof: we still need a domain confirmation step — easiest is to add a TXT record with this token: redwood-verify=AV7-2026 and then reply here when done.

When the CSV + domain TXT are present the automated flow will perform an identity check and (assuming green) will queue issuance of 250,000 token credits per startup to the program admin account. Expected timing: verification runs within 1–2 hours of upload; issuance completes in ~24 hours.

If you prefer, we can start with a provisional allocation to the program admin (50% of total) while you complete the domain verification; tell us which you prefer.

Thanks — looping @aditya_rao for quota issuance confirmation.

— Priyom
